subject: Invoice INV-1048 is due
body:
Hello,

This is a friendly reminder that invoice INV-1048 for Rs. 4,850.00 (office consumables, September 2026) falls due on 17 October 2026.

Payment can be made to the bank account on your vendor master as usual. Please quote the invoice number in the payment reference.

Let us know if you need a copy of the invoice.

Thanks,
Priya Nair
Accounts Receivable
Acme Supplies Pvt Ltd
